en.title: Accessible Gaming Launch Highlights Disability Inclusion in Tech and Travel
en.summary: PEKALAR announced an accessible slot game and MMO designed for players with disabilities, marking a notable product launch in inclusive gaming. Meanwhile, a meetup hosted by NPO Smart Accessibility will discuss real‑world accessibility challenges faced by VoiceOver users beyond standard guidelines. In Hsinchu City, registration opened for an accessible micro‑travel program celebrating ten years of inclusion, offering barrier‑free tours for people with disabilities.

highlights.title: Accessible Slot Game PEKALAR and MMO Pirapira Announced
Event Explores Accessibility Challenges Beyond Guidelines
Hsinchu City Launches Accessible Micro-Travel Program Celebrating Ten Years of Inclusion

zh-TW.title: 無障礙遊戲上市帶動科技與旅遊共融新潮流
zh-TW.summary: PEKALAR 公布無障礙老虎機與 MMO 遊戲，專為殘障玩家設計，標誌著無障礙遊戲的重要產品發布。同時，智能無障礙 NPO 主辦的聚會將探討 VoiceOver 使用者面臨的實際無障礙挑戰，超越現行指引。新竹市則開放無障礙微旅行報名，慶祝共融十年，提供無障礙旅遊體驗。

highlights.title: 活動探討超越指引的無障礙挑戰
邁向十載共融里程碑！ 新竹市無障礙微旅行開放報名 首發團7月底出遊
